name: edge_bevel_post_selection
description: Ledger row 2: after an edge bevel the reference leaves the new band's EDGES and the VERTICES they span selected — and none of the band's faces. We used to leave 3 POLYGONS selected while still reporting edge mode. Measured on a 3-segment unit cube, where the two engines' bevel GEOMETRY agrees exactly, so the cell isolated the selection; task 1180 ported the law and the cell now pins that it stays ported.
source: Reference half: the frozen wave-1 probe capture of the post-bevel state (task 1120). vibe3d half: measured live against this tree. Ledger row: 2.

provenance.harness: tools/local/fixture_gen/cmd_divergence (task 1130), over the task-1120 headless probe capture
provenance.notes: Headless COMMAND capture — no display, no pointer injection, no gesture. The ledger row was found on the pilot's patch, whose intermediate mesh was never dumped and whose amounts are substituted; this cell re-measures the same law on a base both engines build from one command, and the geometry half converges exactly, which the pilot's counts could not show. The reference's selection MODE did not read back in that capture and is therefore absent, not assumed. TASK 1180 PORTED THE LAW. The reference half above is untouched — the same frozen measurement it always was. The vibe3d half was RE-MEASURED live against the ported tree, and the gap it used to declare is now empty in every dimension, so each case declares every measured dimension a CONTROL: an empty gap asserted exactly as strictly as a full one. Narrow it, widen it, or drop a dimension out of either block, and this reddens.

cases.name: band_edges_and_verts_on_both_sides
cases.note: three rim edges of a 3-segment cube, bevelled by 0.1: 60 verts / 115 edges / 57 faces on BOTH sides, and now the same survivor selection — the band's 10 edges and the 8 vertices they span. The band's own 3 faces are what our kernel selects to NAME the product; the command re-points one dimension down from them.

input.argstring: prim.cube segmentsX:3 segmentsY:3 segmentsZ:3 sizeX:1 sizeY:1 sizeZ:1 sharp:true radius:0
